description: Figure 5(a) displays training loss curves for various methods during training from scratch, with the y-axis representing the loss value on a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, and the x-axis representing training steps on a linear scale from 0 to 143,000. The plot includes five distinct lines: a purple dashed line labeled “Vanilla,” an orange solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64),” a blue dashed line labeled “SepLLM (n=128),” a green solid line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H),” and a red dashed line labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T).” The Vanilla line begins at a loss value of approximately 98.5 and decreases gradually to around 97.5. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at a loss value of approximately 97.5 and decreases to around 96.5. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at a loss value of approximately 98 and decreases to around 96.5. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at a loss value of approximately 97 and decreases to around 96. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at a loss value of approximately 97.5 and decreases to around 96.5. All lines exhibit a general downward trend, indicating decreasing loss over training steps, with the SepLLM (n=64) line showing the steepest initial decline.
